question: The Central Administrative Tribunals Act owes its origin to Article ______ of the Constitution of India.
solution:
The correct answer is** __323-A__**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Central Administrative Tribunals **Act owes its origin to **Article 323-A **of the Constitution of India.
 
• Central Administrative Tribunal (CAT)__
 __
 
• The CAT was set up on 1 November 1985.
 
• Members are drawn, both from judicial as well as administrative streams so as to give the Tribunal the benefit of expertise both in legal and administrative spheres.
 
• It exercises original jurisdiction in relation to recruitment and all service matters of public servants covered by it.
 
• The jurisdiction of the central administrative tribunal extends to all-India services, the central civil services, the civil posts under the centre, and civilian employees of defence services.​
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• **​**__**Article 322**- States the **Expenses **of **public service commissions**.
 
• **Article 324**- States that the **Superintendence's direction **of **control **of **elections is **to be **vested **in the **election commission**.
